objectives: 本課程討論恆星內部結構以及外層大氣。課程首先簡單介紹恆星的物理量及觀測手段，然後討論輻射轉移，以及電磁波與物質作用時相關的發射、吸收等現象、輻射轉移方程、氣體狀態方程、譜線形成、恆星內部的靜力平衡、物質分布、熱核反應等
content:
“. Stellar Observational Properties; Gas Properties
. Radiation Transfer
Blackbody Radiation
Emission, Absorption, and Source Function
Equation of Transfer and its Solutions/Approximations

. Stellar Atmospheres
Opacities (Kramers, Rosseland)
Equation of State
Absorption and Spectral Lines
Line Formation
. Stellar Interiors
Hydrostatic Equilibrium
Mass Distribution
Lane-Emden Equation
Radiative, Thermal, and Convective Equilibrium
Energy Generation; Thermonuclear Reactions
Degenerate Matter“
books: An Introduction to the Theory of Stellar Structure and Evolution”, by Dina Prialnik, Cambridge, 2nd Ed. 2009
grading_policy: “期中考 30％; 期末考 30％; 作業或計畫 40％
